standard_prerequisites.name: The free associative algebra generated by an enriched set with an induced well-order
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: standard construction used at proof lines 827-832
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the ambient algebra in which the embedding is constructed, together with the order used to analyse the products.

standard_prerequisites.name: The rewriting of products of ordered monomials through the derivation induced on the free algebra
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: derived inside the proof at proof lines 832-859
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the symmetrized products of the images of the elements of the given algebra reproduce its multiplication.

core_obligations: Choose a well-ordered linear basis of the given algebra and form the free associative algebra on the corresponding enriched set of variables (proof lines 827-832).
Compare the product in the free associative algebra with the multiplication of the given algebra through the induced derivation and its ordered monomials (proof lines 832-858).

Conclude that the map sending an element of the given algebra to its image composed with the derivation is an embedding whose products are given by the displayed formula with the derivation (proof lines 858-861).
proof_roadmap: Well-ordered basis and the free associative algebra (proof lines 827-832).
Comparison of products through the induced derivation (proof lines 832-858).
The embedding and the formula (proof lines 858-861).
difficulty_reason: H2：812-861为任意非结合乘法构造free differential associative enveloping algebra，设计由formal differentiation生成的关系并选择derivative-degree/deglex序，使leading words a^(n)b没有inclusion/intersection composition，从而得到原basis不被关系杀死的embedding。难点是通用关系设计与无重叠GS正规形，区别于特殊derived operad判据。
